gloss: thin strips; cutting into thin pieces

definitions.explanation: a cutting technique where ingredients are sliced into thin, elongated pieces

examples.japanese: ⟦キャベツ→キャベツ：05187_kyabetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{細切|ほそぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Cut the cabbage into thin strips.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{細切|ほそぎ}りにして⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧。
examples.english: Cut the carrot into thin strips and stir-fry it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{細切|ほそぎ}りにして⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧。
examples.english: Cut the meat into thin strips and roll it up with the vegetables.

notes:
COOKING TECHNIQUE:
{細切|ほそぎ}り refers to cutting ingredients into thin, elongated strips. This technique is widely used for stir-fries, salads, and garnishes.

COMMON INGREDIENTS:
- ⟦キャベツ→キャベツ：05187_kyabetsu⟧ - cabbage
- ⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧ - carrot
- ⟦{豚肉|ぶたにく}→豚肉：02956_butaniku⟧ - pork
- ⟦ピーマン→ピーマン：11132_piiman⟧ - bell pepper

COMPARISON WITH {千切|せんぎ}り:
{細切|ほそぎ}り strips are generally wider and less uniform than ⟦{千切|せんぎ}り→千切り：07473_sengiri⟧ (julienne), which produces very fine, hair-like strips.

RELATED CUTTING TECHNIQUES:
- ⟦{千切|せんぎ}り→千切り：07473_sengiri⟧ - julienne (finer than {細切|ほそぎ}り)
- ⟦ぶつ{切|ぎ}り→ぶつ切り：08570_butsugiri⟧ - rough chopping
- ⟦{短冊切|たんざくぎ}り→短冊切り：08087_tanzakugiri⟧ - rectangular strips
